findings.evidence: “taking the first class whose evidence links the cause to the failed step” places Environment, Test and Build before Flake. A test with an assertion failure and verified same-revision pass/fail evidence satisfies Test first, so the prescribed classification stops before evaluating the explicit Flake criteria.
findings.fix: Evaluate the stated flake evidence before committing to Environment, Test or Build. Choose Flake when that evidence explains the observed failure; otherwise classify the failure as observed.

findings.evidence: “Do not continue reading the log after the root cause is confirmed” can prevent step 5 from identifying a later unrelated failure, while the output requires “Also failing” to contain unrelated failures or “none”. The early-stop branch has no representation for additional failures not assessed.
findings.fix: Before stopping, inspect the failed-job or failed-step summary for additional independent failures. If that check is unavailable or intentionally skipped, permit “not assessed” in Also failing instead of requiring “none”.
